en.text:
Kills charge up 'Winged Eclipse', with progress granted based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />. 
• Minor Enemies: 1
• Elite Enemies: 2
• Miniboss+ and Guardians: 3

At six charges, replaces your grenade abilty with two charges of Loyal Moths. Incurs a six second cooldown upon spending both charges before progress can be gained. 

Moth Grenades explode on impact, releasing 2 Loyal Moths that fly to their nearest target. Moths that spawn closer to allies turn into <void/>Void Moths, while Moths that spawn closer to enemies turn into <arc/>Arc Moths.

Loyal Moth variants:
• <arc/>Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets at 10m/s and detonate on contact, dealing up to <pve 526 /> <pvp [31 to Players, 201 to Objects] /> damage in a 4 meter radius and <arc/>Blinding targets. Counts as <arc/>Arc Grenade Damage.
• <void/>Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies at 25m/s and grant them a 22.5 HP <void/>Void Overshield on contact.
